annotations.title: Report a Missing Asset or Capability

description: Use this when the user needed something kernelCAD does not have, so the gap is recorded instead of papered over. kind: asset (search_assets returned coverage none or poor: the catalog does not model it), capability (a tool cannot do what was needed), output (a tool answered, but not with what was needed), docs (a tool description did not say how to use it). One short sentence in `need`; name the tool in `tool` when one fell short. Stores no personal data beyond your account id when signed in. Then tell the user plainly what is missing.

context.description: Optional: what the user was building.

need.description: What was needed, e.g. "low-poly lunar lander for a moon base scene".

tool.description: The tool that fell short, if any (e.g. search_assets).

name: report_need
title: Report a Missing Asset or Capability
